order: Published-model fixes and diagnostics first; Phi4, Mathstral, four Qwen/Gemma siblings, Bonsai next.
runtimeRule: Use downloaded released product JARs; source-built measurement harness identified independently. If the tokenizer repair releases first, rebuild and hash the released payload before launch.
gate: Paired same-host same-workload unchanged policy, model answer rate >= 1/3, model answer correctness >= .90, decode ratio >= .80, end-to-end ratio <= 1.5; separate library-default smoke. No candidate-only success.

predictions.Phi4: Prior dev-runtime pass; expect repeat, throughput margin modest.
predictions.Mathstral: Prior paired pass but current specialist/base comparison remains required.
predictions.Qwen/Gemma: Sibling support reduces engineering risk; exact quality and throughput unknown.
predictions.Bonsai: Source pass before BF16 repair; released repeat may lose throughput margin.

killRule: Stop a broken arm promptly; retain every null. Do not tune settings after seeing verdicts within this experiment.
fineTuneRule: Mathstral must beat matched-size Mistral base at Q4_K_S on the math workload; paired runtime pass alone is insufficient admission.
